description:
Mumbai, 19th July 2026: Rotary Club of Mumbai MaKaBo successfully organized a Free Medical Camp at Gagangiri Jayram Heights, Kandarpada, Dahisar (West), Mumbai, benefiting 106 members of the community.

The camp witnessed overwhelming participation and was conducted with great enthusiasm and dedication by Rotary members, volunteers, and healthcare professionals.
The beneficiaries included domestic helpers, security guards, housekeeping staff, drivers, waiters, managers from nearby commercial establishments, and other support staff who availed themselves of the comprehensive healthcare services offered during the camp.
The health check-ups included:
Complete Blood Count (CBC)
Blood Sugar Test (Fasting/Random)
Blood Pressure Check-up
Total Cholesterol Test
Thyroid Stimulating Hormone (TSH) Test
Vitamin D & Vitamin B12 Tests
Basic Eye Check-up
Free Spectacles for beneficiaries wherever prescribed
The medical camp was organized under the leadership of Rtn. Navin Mishra, President (2026-27
